headline: Итоги встречи в Китае: Трамп, Путин и Цзиньпин приняли декларацию о мире
summary: A declaration on peace was published following the first-ever trilateral meeting of the leaders of the United States, Russia and China. The summit took place in China.
why: Relations among Washington, Moscow and Beijing shape global trade, sanctions, energy flows and geopolitical risk premia that investors price across asset classes.
